body.text: My experience leading the technical direction of web applications aligns well with the Frontend Platform Lead role. At Cloudcase, I directly addressed the challenges of an outdated UI by replacing a legacy jQuery system, much like the problem your team is looking to solve.

I spearheaded the initiative to implement a modern three-layer React/TypeScript architecture. This foundation included building a comprehensive component library alongside a platform SDK and React app, a system on which our team now ships all feature work.

decision.closing: Thank you for your time and consideration.
